messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

We need to calculate heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temp and volume. But heat capacity at constant pressure (Cp) is independent of volume for ideal gas? For ideal gas, Cp depends only on temperature (and composition). For air, Cp ~ 1005 J/(kg·K) at 300 K. But we can compute using function calc_heat_capacity. We need to call the function with temp and volume. The function signature: temp, volume, gas optional. So we call three times: 300 K, 2.5 m^3; 350 K, 2.5 m^3; 300 K, 1.5 m^3. Wait second experiment: 350 K, 2.5 m^3? Actually description: container volume 2.5 m^3 at 300 K, then repeat at 350 K. Then lower volume 1.5 m^3 repeat same experiments. So we have 4 experiments? Next, at lower volume 1.5 cubic meters repeat the experiment." It says "next at lower volume 1.5 cubic meters next repeat the experiment." Might mean two volumes each at two temperatures: 2.5 m^3 at 300 K, 2.5 m^3 at 350 K, 1.5 m^3 at 300 K, 1.5 m^3 at 350 K. But the user asked: "Can you provide the heat capacity for these three different conditions?" They mention three conditions: maybe 300 K, 2.5 m^3; 350 K, 2.5 m^3; 300 K, 1.5 m^3. But they also repeated at 350 K for 1.5 m^3? The phrase "Next, at lower volume 1.5 cubic meters next repeat the experiment" ambiguous. But they ask for three conditions. So likely they want 300 K, 2.5 m^3; 350 K, 2.5 m^3; 300 K, 1.5 m^3. But they might want 350 K, 1.5 m^3 too. But they said "three different conditions". So we will compute for 300 K, 2.5 m^3; 350 K, 2.5 m^3; 300 K, 1.5 m^3. But we can also mention that Cp is independent of volume. But we will use function calls.
